title: Profile
description: A Commemorative Profile representing a loved one (human or pet) in Lascito. Each Profile is a Firestore document under the `profiles/{profileId}` path.

profileId.description: Unique identifier. Generated client-side (UUID v4) before the document is written.

creatorUserId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who created this profile.

fullName.description: Full name of the person or pet being memorialized.

profileType.description: Determines display treatment (avatar badge, UI copy, etc.).

relationship.description: The creator's relationship to the subject (e.g. Abuela, Padre, Compañero fiel).

birthDate.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds representing the date of birth.

passingDate.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds for the date of passing. Null if the person is still living.

avatarUrl.description: HTTPS URL pointing to the profile avatar stored in S3.

status.description: ACTIVE: editable. READ_ONLY: archived / immutable (content may be in Glacier).
